items.description: Clothing and jewellery stolen from the car
items.rationale: Buildings-only policy: theft is not an insured peril (2.1, 3.1.4); clothing/jewellery are personal articles (4.3(d)) located in a conveyance away from the insured location (4.3(f)). Matches reference case 35 where t was ~0.
Conveyance-related and journey costs are excluded (5.2.5, 7.1.8(d)), and there is no insured event. Reference case 35 shows t ~0.
